headline: DeepSeek still sits on top at 22.3%, while five new names crash the bottom half of the board
summary: DeepSeek's v4.1 Flash keeps the No. 1 spot with 22.3% of tokens, and the top three providers hold 49.8% between them. Five fresh entrants landed between ranks 43 and 51, and Claude Fable 5.1 fell off the board from 38th.
highlights: Five new entrants arrived in the bottom half: OpenAI's gpt-oss-120b at 43, Perplexity's pplx-decider-v1.1-27b at 45, Qwen's qwen3.8-max at 47, Google's gemini-2.5-flash at 50, and Mistral's mistral-large-4-0 at 51.
DeepSeek v4-pro took a 7-place tumble to 31st, while Claude Sonnet 5 climbed 9 spots to 35th.
Claude Fable 5.1 (last ranked 38th) headlines the dropouts, joined by Qwen's qwen3.6-35b-a3b, DeepSeek's v3.2 and two more Qwen models.
DeepSeek, StepFun and Zhipu AI together account for 49.8% of tokens, and StepFun's step-5-preview sits at No. 2 with 12.1%.
